research_question: Can a scientific agent acquire and synthesize sufficient time-valid, lineage-aware evidence to earn each state transition in a long-horizon drug-discovery trajectory without relying on final-outcome recall?

primary_metric.name: Fully Authorized Trajectory Success at pass@1

task_families.name: Evidence Lineage Trap
task_families.research_question: Can the agent distinguish source-file diversity from independence of the underlying scientific evidence?

task_families.name: Temporal Reversal
task_families.research_question: Can the agent reconstruct what was knowable at a cutoff and change disposition only when later evidence becomes admissible?

task_families.name: Translational Handoff
task_families.research_question: Can the agent preserve disease, target, perturbation, model-system, and claim identity across an upstream-to-clinical handoff without unsupported promotion?

task_families.name: Non-Exchangeable Replication
task_families.research_question: Can the agent detect when apparently replicated trials cannot support pooling or transport because population, phase, endpoint, or estimand differs?

task_families.name: Budgeted Evidence Resolution
task_families.research_question: Can the agent choose a bounded next action that resolves the most decision-relevant evidence gap rather than merely producing a verdict?

benchmark_tiers.purpose: Localize retrieval, identity, chronology, lineage, mapping, and action failures without making the component score the flagship claim.
Measure complete evidence-authorized interactive trajectories under a common frozen environment and bounded budget.

threat_model.failure: The model recalls task identities or answers instead of reasoning over the supplied evidence world.
threat_model.required_control: Use private rotating test tasks, opaque identities, contamination canaries, and model-access disclosure.

threat_model.failure: The agent uses evidence that was unavailable at the declared decision time.
threat_model.required_control: Serve only a frozen cutoff-safe corpus and include matched planted-leakage twins.

threat_model.failure: A disease, target, candidate, intervention, trial, endpoint, or population silently changes across stages.
threat_model.required_control: Require canonical identity ledgers and identity-critical counterfactual mutations.

threat_model.failure: Multiple files derived from one underlying study are treated as independent replication.
threat_model.required_control: Score independence on an evidence-lineage graph rather than URL or file-hash disjointness alone.

threat_model.failure: The agent pools or transports evidence across incompatible endpoints, phases, populations, or estimands.
threat_model.required_control: Require exact endpoint, timeframe, population, phase, and estimand bindings before synthesis.

threat_model.failure: Retrieved scientific text changes agent policy or evaluator instructions.
threat_model.required_control: Treat source text as untrusted data, separate control instructions, and include safe injection diagnostics.

threat_model.failure: A policy appears safer only because it refuses nearly every task.
threat_model.required_control: Compare risk at matched coverage, cost, and wall time and report the complete Pareto surface.

threat_model.failure: Readable provenance creates unjustified reviewer trust in an incorrect trajectory.
threat_model.required_control: Measure error detection, confidence calibration, and unsupported acceptance in a blinded human study.

threat_model.failure: Tasks are retained or edited after observing which items frontier models fail.
threat_model.required_control: Freeze eligibility and sampling before baseline runs and prohibit model-failure-based filtering.

nonclaims: A launch-band score is an observational target, not a task-selection criterion.
Design seeds and synthetic mutations are not benchmark performance evidence.
Cryptographic provenance does not establish source truth or scientific independence.
Full-trajectory success does not establish therapeutic efficacy or clinical utility.
No real independently curated ADDS-Frontier board result is currently claimed.

next_milestone.name: Five-family canonical pilot board
next_milestone.exit_condition: Forty baseline-blind, expert-solvable canonical tasks and at least five preregistered mutations per task pass oracle, lineage, cutoff, and replay review before any frontier model is scored.
